context.stage: F8 — Tenant Management GUI (Batch 1: TM-01, TM-02, TM-03)

task.description:
Write test specs and test code for TM-01, TM-02, and TM-03.

## DIRECTIVE T-1 (hard rule)
No mocks, stubs, in-memory fakes, or stub return values in any test file. All tests connect to the real running backend and real database.

## DIRECTIVE T-2 (hard rule for frontend tests)
No MSW, no axios-mock-adapter, no HTTP-level mocking. E2E tests go against the real running backend.

## Tests to write

### Backend integration tests (Zig)

**tests/specs/TM-01.md** — Test spec for TM-01 and TM-03

**tests/integration/tm01_tenant_list_test.zig** (or add to existing admin test file if present):
- TC-TM-01-01: PLATFORM_ADMIN can list tenants — GET /api/v1/tenants returns 200 with {items, total}
- TC-TM-01-02: non-PLATFORM_ADMIN gets 403 from GET /api/v1/tenants
- TC-TM-01-03: pagination works — limit/offset returns correct slice
- TC-TM-03-01: PLATFORM_ADMIN can PATCH display_name — returns 200 with updated tenant
- TC-TM-03-02: PATCH with slug in body returns 422
- TC-TM-03-03: PATCH with idp_realm_id in body returns 422
- TC-TM-03-04: PATCH on non-existent slug returns 404

All tests must:
- Use BPM_TEST_DB_URL for DB connection
- Use BPM_TEST_URL for HTTP calls
- Clean up any test data they create (use per-test UUIDs for test tenant slugs)
- Skip cleanly with error.SkipZigTest if BPM_TEST_DB_URL is absent

### Frontend E2E tests (Playwright)

**web/tests/e2e/tenants.e2e.spec.ts**:
- TC-TM-UI-01: PLATFORM_ADMIN navigates to /admin/tenants and sees tenant list
- TC-TM-UI-02: non-admin is redirected away from /admin/tenants
- TC-TM-UI-03: Edit button navigates to /admin/tenants/:slug/edit
- TC-TM-UI-04: EditTenantPage shows slug and idp_realm_id as read-only
- TC-TM-UI-05: EditTenantPage allows editing display_name and saving
- TC-TM-UI-06: 'Register New Tenant' button navigates to /admin/onboarding/new
- TC-TM-UI-07: 'Tenants' nav link is hidden from non-PLATFORM_ADMIN

Each E2E test verdict must be based on visual screen inspection (screenshot + assertion on visible content), not just absence of error.

Add new tests to main_test.zig import if needed.

next_action: 'Route to TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR (Step 3b)'

E2E test file exists with TC-TM-UI-01 through TC-TM-UI-07
E2E verdicts are visual (screenshot-based), not just no-error
No mocks or stubs of any kind
